dart.notes: Launch Nov. 24, 2021; target Didymos and Dimorphos; first mission dedicated to demonstrating asteroid deflection by kinetic impact.

lucy.notes: Launch Oct. 16, 2021; first mission to Jupiter Trojan asteroids; current plan lists 11 asteroid flybys and explicitly says Trojans are associated with, but not close to, Jupiter.

osiris.notes: Bennu sample returned Sept. 24, 2023; NASA announced bulk sample mass 121.6 grams on Feb. 15, 2024.

insight.notes: Launch May 5, 2018; stationary Mars lander at Elysium Planitia; robotic arm 1.8 metres; mission studied Mars's deep interior.

psyche.notes: Mission targets the metal-rich asteroid Psyche in the main belt between Mars and Jupiter.

deep_impact.notes: Target Tempel 1; flyby craft 601 kg, impactor 372 kg; launch Jan. 12, 2005 and impact July 4, 2005.

magellan.notes: Magellan made the first global map of Venus's surface and global gravity maps.

parker.notes: Launch Aug. 12, 2018; closest approach about 6.2 million km; named for Eugene N. Parker.

tess.notes: Launch April 18, 2018; space telescope for exoplanets and variable objects.
